rule: Records of data/processed/analysis_buildings.csv with the same building-register key (reg_pk, non-null) are the same building selected more than once. The earliest record is kept (earliest selection year; on a tie the earliest start_ym; then pid) with its role, start and end; the later records are dropped. Before this rule a re-selected building entered the control pool twice and months after its first recorded start counted as untreated.
note: declared as a change made after the interim results were seen (PLAN.md, 11/14 02:19, D23)
